The structure of K2SbF6 crystallizes in the cubic space group Fm-3m (No. 225), with a unit cell containing 36 atoms (K8Sb4F24) distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Sb centers in octahedral coordination by six F neighbors at 1.954 Å, while K centers adopt a close-packed-like local arrangement with twelve F neighbors at 2.9054 Å. These polyhedra connect through corner-sharing Sb octahedra, and face-sharing between K 12-vertex polyhedra and Sb octahedra are also observed. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
